notes: Reviewed collections of full episodes and feature films. No open-ended searches: broadcast tapes, trailers, interviews and commentary are deliberately excluded. Resolution is a screening aid; source collections must also be visually reviewed. Only browser-playable MP4 files are used.

rejected.reason: Visually reviewed: severely smeared picture, tape damage and loss of facial detail.

sources.notes: Individual TNG, DS9 and Voyager episodes; disc-sourced SD. Originals contain AC-3 surround audio. Use the Archive's H.264/AAC derivatives at the same listed resolution so browser playback includes sound.
Only files meeting the 480-line floor qualify; smaller encodes are excluded.
Full 1080-line episodes. Originals have AC-3 audio; use the matching H.264/AAC Archive derivatives, which retain the 1080-line picture.
Clean widescreen SD for seasons 1–2; choose 1080p originals over 480p derivatives for seasons 3–4.
Full episodes in clean 480p MP4. Higher-resolution MKV/ZIP sources are not playable by this player.
Select the full 1080p episodes, not the 12-second EP101 preview.
Full 720p/1080p episodes; original and derivative copies are deduplicated.
